decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans numbered  General location plan, planning layout, balancing pond- overview No.3 rev B, balancing pond-kiosk layout no.2 rev A, main reservoir- kiosk layout no.1 rev A, main reservoir-kiosk layout No.2 rev A, diversion chamber-kiosk layout no.1 rev A, diversion chamber-kiosk layout no.2 rev A, plan section and elevation no.1, colour sample and 3 photographs of existing/ proposed kiosks received: 3rd September 2012 submitted  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Erection of 3 X total Organic Carbon (TOC) analyser kiosk to adjoin existing kiosk structures located around the water treatment facilities at Mayfield Farm.
